note: From the lowob Deadline Desk. Each row keeps its own date-confidence flag. 'checked' is the last day the row was read against the funder's or organiser's own page.

items.name: TOKEN2049 NEXUS startup competition
items.detail: $250,000 equity-free to the winner, 10 finalists pitching to 25,000 attendees. Incorporated 2023 or later, under $5M raised. Free to enter.

items.name: Founder Institute Fall 2026, early deadline
items.detail: Final deadline 6 Oct, cohort joins 9 Oct. Includes an agentic and AI-native track. Fee-based with a standard warrant.

items.name: Korea Blockchain Week, General Pass tier closes
items.detail: General Pass $699, tier ends 17 Sep 06:00 UTC. Student Pass $99. 29 Sep is an invite-only institutional summit.

items.name: ICLR 2027 abstract deadline
items.detail: Abstract 18 Sep, full paper 25 Sep, both anywhere on earth. New 2027 policies on co-authorship, reciprocal reviewing and AI use.

items.name: Alliance ALL19, early deadline
items.detail: $800k: $400k on admission plus $400k seed follow-on, SAFE at $4M post with a 1:1 token side letter. Ten weeks from 11 Jan 2027, New York bookends.

items.name: Korea Blockchain Week speaker and side-event applications
items.detail: 13,000+ attendees, 300+ speakers and 300+ side events in 2025. Speaker, sponsor and side-event forms open with no published close date.

items.name: Road to Devcon 8 India, University Program
items.detail: Up to $500 and five tickets for campus workshops, seminars, student clubs and hackathons. Paid on-chain in ETH.

items.name: Arbitrum Security Program, applications expected to open
items.org: Arbitrum Foundation · succeeds the Audit Program
items.detail: The successor to the $10M Audit Program passed an off-chain vote on 20 Aug 2026, with applications targeted for 1 Oct.

items.name: PearX W27, regular deadline
items.detail: $500k to $2M invested, 12 weeks Jan to Apr 2027, relocation required. AI and deep tech, pre-seed.

items.name: Entrepreneur First Bangalore, early deadline
items.detail: Up to $250k post-residency. Starts Feb 2027: 14 weeks in Bangalore, then three months in San Francisco. Pre-team, pre-idea.

items.name: 500 Global Flagship Batch 36
items.detail: $150k for 6%, four months in person in Silicon Valley. Generalist with heavy AI representation.

items.name: Colosseum Crypto World's Fair, submission close
items.detail: Online hackathon 14 Sep to 12 Oct. Selected teams enter the accelerator at $250k on a SAFE plus token warrant.

items.name: Money20/20 USA startup pitch programme
items.detail: 11,000+ senior attendees and 3,400+ companies. Startup programme and live pitch referenced; no public deadline.

items.name: NeurIPS 2026 early registration
items.detail: Conference 6 to 13 Dec across three cities. Paper, workshop and tutorial gates all closed in mid-2026.

items.name: a16z SPEEDRUN SR008, priority window
items.org: a16z · SF · window 12 Oct to 1 Nov
items.detail: Up to $1M: $500k for 10% on a SAFE plus $500k into the next round, and over $5M in credits. AI, games and consumer.

items.name: Y Combinator W27
items.detail: Deadline 8pm PT, decisions by 11 December, batch Jan to Mar 2027 in San Francisco.

items.name: Devcon 8
items.detail: 10,000+ builders across nine tracks at Jio World Centre. Speaker applications closed 6 August.

items.name: NSF SBIR/STTR Phase I, first FY27 window
items.detail: Phase I up to $305k, Phase II $1.25M. Project Pitch invitation required first. Further windows 4 Mar and 7 Jul 2027.

items.name: EIC Accelerator, full proposal cut-off
items.detail: Grant up to €2.5M plus €1M to €10M equity. 17:00 Brussels. Deep tech including AI.

items.name: Stellar Community Fund #46
items.detail: Up to $150,000 in XLM across Open, Integration and RFP tracks.

items.name: Startmate Winter '26
items.detail: A$120k on a SAFE at A$1.5M post. 25 Jan to 29 Apr 2027, hybrid with three in-person weeks.

items.name: Web Summit PITCH
items.detail: Roughly 25 finalists and 16+ judges. No published close date; historically four to six weeks before the event.

items.name: CVPR 2027 paper registration
items.detail: Registration precedes submission by six days and there are no extensions.

items.name: SXSW Pitch 2027, final entry
items.detail: Eight categories. Final entry $225.

items.name: Solana Breakpoint
items.detail: 8,000+ attendees at Olympia. Speaker applications open with no published deadline.

items.name: Cooperative AI PhD Fellowship 2027
items.detail: Up to $40k a year plus conference and compute budget. No 2027 round announced; the last cycle closed 16 Nov 2025.

items.name: Techstars Spring 2027, all programmes
items.detail: $220k: $200k uncapped MFN SAFE plus $20k for a minimum 5% common. Three months from March 2027.

items.name: Alliance ALL19, regular deadline
items.detail: $400k, SAFE at $4M post plus a 1:1 token side letter. Early and regular deadlines; applications also reviewed year-round.

items.name: ETHDenver 2027, applications expected to open
items.detail: No 2027 dates published. The 2026 cycle opened attendee, BUIDLer and speaker applications on 18 Nov 2025.

items.name: Filecoin Kernel FY27, intake closes
items.detail: Intake opens October, closes November, awards in December, term from January 2027. Current Kernel grants run $28k to $504k.

items.name: Prezenti grants round closes
items.detail: Season 3 pools: Frontier for AI and agent infrastructure (capped at $15k), Anchor for products with 5,000+ daily transactions, Boost by referral. Frontier funds are running low.

items.name: NIH SBIR/STTR omnibus
items.detail: Health-related small-business R&D including AI and ML diagnostics. Next window 5 Apr 2027.

items.name: Berkeley SkyDeck Batch 24, applications open
items.org: SkyDeck · deadline expected Feb to Mar
items.detail: $210k from the SkyDeck Fund, roughly 20 startups every six months. Batch 23 closed 21 Aug 2026; Batch 24 window not yet published.

items.name: South Park Commons Spring 2027 Fellowship
items.org: South Park Commons · SF, NYC, Bangalore
items.detail: $400k for 7% on a SAFE plus $600k guaranteed in the next round. Semi-annual cadence.

items.name: Consensus Hong Kong 2027
items.detail: Event runs 1 to 3 Feb 2027 in Hong Kong. Speaker submissions close 4 Dec 2026.

items.name: Horizon Europe Human/AI collaboration, stage 1
items.detail: Research and innovation action, €30M across roughly five projects, two-stage.

items.name: EIC Accelerator, first 2027 cut-off
items.detail: 2027 work programme adopted 5 Nov 2026. Full-proposal cut-offs 20 Jan, 17 Mar, 1 Sep and 4 Nov 2027. Short proposals accepted any time.

items.name: NSF SBIR/STTR Phase I, second FY27 window
items.detail: Up to $305k per Phase I project; a Project Pitch invitation is required first. Final FY27 window 7 Jul 2027.

items.name: HumanX 2027 pitch competitions
items.detail: Live pitch at HumanX Las Vegas, 8 to 10 Mar 2027. Pre-seed to Series A, founded 2021 or later, under $10M raised. Semi-finalists must exhibit.

items.name: NVIDIA GTC 2027
items.detail: Event runs 15 to 18 Mar 2027 in San Jose. The poster call for submissions closed 10 Nov 2026.

items.name: Horizon Europe AI cluster, four topics, one cut-off
items.detail: About €139M across four topics: Frontier AI (€44M), Apply-AI (€42M), AI robotics (€18M), federated AI data processing (€35M). Call opens 17 Nov 2026.

items.name: Ethereum Foundation PhD Fellowship 2027
items.org: Ethereum Foundation · expected Feb to Apr
items.detail: $24,000 over one year, nine to ten fellowships. No 2027 wave announced yet.

items.name: NIH SBIR/STTR omnibus, second window
items.detail: Second standard receipt date of 2027 for the SBIR and STTR omnibus solicitations.

items.name: EthCC[10]
items.org: Ethereum Community Conference · Cannes, 12 to 15 Apr
items.detail: Tenth edition, 12 to 15 Apr 2027 at the Palais des Festivals. Speaker application form is on the site; no deadline published.

items.name: TOKEN2049 Dubai NEXUS 2027
items.detail: Event runs 21 to 22 Apr 2027 at Madinat Jumeirah. NEXUS 2027 deadline not yet posted; the Singapore gate closed about three weeks before its event.

items.name: Survival and Flourishing Fund 2027 main round
items.detail: $14M to $28M main round in 2026, closed 22 Apr. No 2027 round announced. Speculation grants are rolling.

items.name: Consensus Miami 2027
items.detail: Event runs 4 to 6 May 2027 in Miami. Speaker applications close 19 Mar 2027.

items.name: RAISE the STAKES 2027
items.detail: RAISE 2027 runs 6 to 8 Jul in Paris. The competition page still shows the prior cycle; 2027 deadline not yet posted.

items.name: VivaTech 2027 Startup Challenges
items.detail: Corporate-sponsored startup challenges at VivaTech. The 2026 cycle ran February to April; no 2027 challenges listed yet.

items.name: DARPA IPTO office-wide BAA, abstracts close
items.detail: Rolling abstracts to 22 Jun 2027; full proposals by invitation only. Needs SAM.gov registration before any award.

items.name: AI Engineer World's Fair 2027
items.org: ai.engineer · San Francisco, 29 Jun to 2 Jul
items.detail: Moscone West. Targeting 10,000 AI engineers, founders and technical leaders, up from 7,500 in 2026. Call for papers not yet open.

items.name: NSF SBIR/STTR Phase I, third FY27 window
items.detail: Final published FY27 window.

items.name: Slush 100 2027, applications open
items.detail: €500,000 at 0% equity. The 2026 cycle opened 12 Aug and closed 7 Sep.

rolling.name: Ethereum Foundation ESP
rolling.detail: No open rounds at present; RFPs published on the portal.

rolling.name: Solana Foundation Grants
rolling.amount: About 1 week to review, 3 weeks to decision
rolling.detail: Public-goods milestone grants plus convertible grants for commercial public goods, and an RFP board.

rolling.name: Starknet Seed and Growth Grants
rolling.amount: Seed up to $25k · Growth $25k to $1M in STRK
rolling.detail: Bitcoin Builder, Content and Creator and Next Billion sub-tracks.

rolling.name: Aptos Ecosystem Grants
rolling.detail: Separate payments grant track. Reviewed on a rolling basis.

rolling.name: Base Ecosystem Fund
rolling.amount: Pre-seed and seed, equity or token
rolling.detail: Batches run about twice a year.

rolling.name: Filecoin Open Grants
rolling.amount: Next Step $5k to $10k · Open Grants scoped
rolling.detail: Three-month review cycle.

rolling.name: HRF Bitcoin Development Fund
rolling.detail: Freedom tech, privacy and censorship resistance.

rolling.name: NVIDIA Inception
rolling.detail: Under 10 years old, incorporated, at least one developer. Excludes crypto companies.

rolling.name: Google Cloud AI startup program
rolling.amount: Up to $350k in credits over two years
rolling.detail: Built on Gemini or Gemma, venture-funded, under five years old.

rolling.name: AWS Activate
rolling.detail: Five to ten business day response.

rolling.name: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub
rolling.detail: Credits usable across eligible Azure services, plus access to AI models and tools.

rolling.name: NAIRR Pilot resource requests
rolling.detail: Not cash. Submit by the 15th, decision by the end of the following month.

rolling.name: UKRI AIRR: Isambard-AI and Dawn
rolling.amount: Up to 10,000 GPU hours per project
rolling.detail: Gateway route open with no closing date. UK businesses of any size, research bodies and charities eligible. Batched fortnightly; hours run on Isambard-AI and Zenith.

rolling.name: Antler global residencies
rolling.detail: Published dates are cohort start dates, not deadlines; Antler asks founders to apply early to secure a seat.

rolling.name: Outlier Ventures Base Camp
rolling.amount: Up to $100k stipend plus up to $200k follow-on, for equity and future token supply
rolling.detail: Web3 plus AI x Crypto, DeFi, RWA and DePIN. Twelve weeks, remote. The call for builders page currently shows applications closed.

rolling.name: BNB Chain MVB / YZi Labs
rolling.org: BNB Chain · about three cohorts a year
rolling.detail: Four-week accelerator with investment for top builders.

rolling.name: Z Fellows
rolling.detail: Idea and pre-seed stage, one week long.

rolling.name: Coefficient Giving
rolling.detail: Renamed from Open Philanthropy in 2025. The AI risk capacity-building fund is open on a rolling basis; other AI RFPs carry their own status.

rolling.name: Transformative AI Fund
rolling.detail: Replaces the Long-Term Future Fund. Always open to applications.

rolling.name: Arbitrum Audit Program
rolling.detail: Audit Program applications closed 31 Jul 2026. The successor Arbitrum Security Program runs 12 more months on rolling applications from the remaining budget.
